properties.name: 2Africa Cable — Casablanca Landing
properties.description: Part of the 45,000 km 2Africa system backed by Meta, connecting 33 countries. The Casablanca landing station provides massive international bandwidth and sub-10ms latency to Southern Europe. Backbone for future hyperscaler deployments in the kingdom.

properties.name: ACE Cable — Agadir Landing
properties.description: The Africa Coast to Europe (ACE) cable: 17,000 km from France to South Africa via West Africa. The Agadir landing gives Morocco a southern connectivity path complementing northern Mediterranean routes. ~5.12 Tbps design capacity across 23 countries.

properties.name: Medusa Cable — Tangier Landing
properties.description: New 9,700 km submarine cable system connecting Morocco, Spain, France, Portugal, Senegal, and Côte d'Ivoire. The Tangier landing positions the Tangier Med industrial zone as a digital hub, co-located with the Spain power interconnect crossing at the Strait of Gibraltar.

properties.name: 2Africa Cable Route (schematic)
properties.description: Schematic routing of 2Africa cable from Casablanca landing northward toward Southern Europe.

properties.name: ACE Cable Route (schematic)
properties.description: Schematic routing of Africa Coast to Europe (ACE) cable from Agadir northward to Portugal and France.
